2608.20831.title: STAR-OPD: Structured Aspect-Cascade-Aware On-Policy Reward Distillation for ABSA Quadruple Extraction
2608.20831.paper_summary: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) quadruple extraction requires jointly predicting target, aspect, opinion, and sentiment over reviews that often contain multiple fine-grained sentiment tuples. While large chain-of-thought (CoT) models perform well on this task, distilling them into smaller deployable models remains difficult. We identify a task-specific failure mode in distilled ABSA extraction: student errors at the target-aspect interface create structurally invalid states, such as broken target-aspect bindings and hallucinated targets, which then corrupt downstream predictions. Conventional off-policy distillation is poorly suited to this setting because it trains only on teacher-generated trajectories and provides little supervision on the student-induced structural states that dominate inference. To address this mismatch, we propose STAR-OPD (STructured Aspect-cascade-aware On-Policy Reward Distillation), which builds on generic on-policy distillation and instantiates it for ABSA quadruple extraction with cascade-aware, set-structured rewards. STAR-OPD trains on student rollouts and applies set-structured rewards that directly target binding consistency, target grounding, and fine-grained aspect disambiguation. Experiments on E-ABSA20K and SemEval-2014 show that STAR-OPD consistently outperforms off-policy and general on-policy baselines, reduces target hallucination, and substantially improves performance on structurally hard cases. With Qwen3-4B, STAR-OPD substantially narrows the student-teacher gap while improving inference efficiency, highlighting the importance of on-policy structural correction for distilled ABSA extraction.
2608.20831.paper_summary_zh: 基於面向的情感分析（ABSA）四元組提取需要共同預測目標、面向、意見和情感，這些評論通常包含多個細粒度的情感元組。雖然大型思維鏈（CoT）模型在這項任務上表現良好，但將它們提煉成更小的可部署模型仍然困難。我們在提煉的 ABSA 提取中識別出一種特定任務的失效模式：學生在目標-面向接口的錯誤會產生結構上無效的狀態，例如破損的目標-面向綁定和幻覺目標，這會影響下游預測。傳統的非策略性提煉不適合這種情況，因為它僅在教師生成的軌跡上進行訓練，並且對主導推理的學生誘導結構狀態提供的監督很少。為了解決這一不匹配，我們提出了 STAR-OPD（結構化面向級聯感知的策略性獎勵提煉），它基於通用的策略性提煉並為 ABSA 四元組提取實現了級聯感知的集合結構獎勵。STAR-OPD 在學生回合上進行訓練，並應用直接針對綁定一致性、目標定位和細粒度面向消歧的集合結構獎勵。對 E-ABSA20K 和 SemEval-2014 的實驗顯示，STAR-OPD 始終優於非策略性和一般的策略性基準，減少了目標幻覺，並顯著改善了在結構上困難案例中的表現。使用 Qwen3-4B，STAR-OPD 大幅縮小了學生與教師之間的差距，同時提高了推理效率，突顯了策略性結構修正對於提煉 ABSA 提取的重要性。
